title: Free energy is minimized only when every cell occupies a unique inferred place

fields.label: Label
fields.value: Free energy is minimized only when every cell occupies a unique inferred place

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: In the active-inference model of morphogenesis, where identical pluripotent cells share one generative model, the minimum of variational free energy is reached only when every cell is at a unique location and has correctly inferred its place, so free-energy minimization guarantees convergence to the target form.

fields.label: Work
fields.value: Knowing one's place: a free-energy approach to pattern regulation

fields.label: Chapter
fields.value: Friston K 2015, Knowing one's place: a free-energy approach to pattern regulation › Introduction

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: This is guaranteed because the minimum of variational free energy is obtained when each cell is in a unique location and has correctly inferred its place.

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: Friston K, Levin M, Sengupta B, Pezzulo G, “Knowing one's place: a free-energy approach to pattern regulation”, Journal of the Royal Society, Interface (2015), doi:10.1098/rsif.2014.1383; section “Introduction”. Scope: Active-inference model of morphogenesis with cells sharing a generative model

fields.label: Assessment
fields.value: GPT-5.6 Sol on levin-2015-place-04: resolvable-now, resolvability 0.89

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: This is a claim about a specified mathematical model, not a general empirical law. Symbolic analysis and exhaustive numerical searches can directly test uniqueness of minima and convergence with existing software.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Analyze the stated free-energy objective and numerically search its state space for minima in which locations are duplicated, identities are incorrect, or the target form is not reached. Any such minimum or nonconvergent trajectory under the stated assumptions refutes the guarantee.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value: The guarantee may depend on unstated numerical and symmetry-breaking assumptions.

fields.value:

data adequacy: 0.85

operationalizability: 0.95

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: The statement is a mathematical claim about a fully specified active-inference model, and the public code exposes free energy and inferred place. Reruns and inspection of the energy can refute unconditional convergence or a non-unique minimum. They do not by themselves prove the guarantee for every target, and the energy is defined so that the encoded target is the low-energy state.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: From the published generative model and the public solver, record variational free energy against cell locations and identity beliefs over random initial states. A converged run whose free energy is minimal at a duplicated or mis-assigned place, or a run that fails to reach the target under the stated assumptions, would refute the uniqueness-and-guarantee claim for that model.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
The minimum sits at the target largely because the target is encoded as the model's parameters.

Finite reruns can produce a counterexample, while a universal guarantee needs an analytic argument the demo does not print out.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:

data existence: 0.85
analysis feasibility: 0.68
data adequacy: 0.58
